briefing.text: Nvidia has reportedly paused AI server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries.
Sunrise on the Reaping led Thanksgiving Day with $11.6 million at the box office.
An analyst estimates GTA VI sold about 53 million copies in its first week.
OpenAI fixed a GPT-6.2 billing error, so users now hit usage limits sooner.
The 100th Macy's parade runs today after weather moved it off Thanksgiving.

stories.title: Sunrise on the Reaping leads Thanksgiving Day with $11.6 million
stories.summary: The Hunger Games prequel topped Thanksgiving Day in its second week and is projected to make about $85 million over the five-day holiday.
stories.why: It is the year's big holiday hit and has already passed the last prequel's whole domestic run.
stories.happened: Variety reports $11.6 million on Thursday and a projected $233 million domestic total through Sunday. TheWrap says it made just under $175 million in its first week, beating the $166 million domestic run of the previous prequel.
stories.next: Watch for Sunday's final weekend figures and whether it holds No. 1 into December.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Readers of the books and fans of the films turned out in big numbers.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The five-day Thanksgiving holiday is one of the busiest cinema periods.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: It has already outgrossed the previous prequel's full domestic run, reports say.

stories.background: The Hunger Games films are based on Suzanne Collins' novels. This is the second prequel, following a young Haymitch Abernathy.

meme.top: Thanksgiving is about family
meme.bottom: and watching teens fight to the death
meme.take: America gave thanks this week by buying $11.6 million of tickets to a fictional death match.

stories.title: GTA VI estimated at 53 million copies, already the 13th best-selling game ever
stories.summary: Alinea Analytics estimates GTA VI sold about 53 million copies and $4.7 billion in its first week, GamesRadar+ reports.
stories.why: If the estimate holds, it is one of the fastest-selling launches in entertainment history.
stories.happened: Rhys Elliott of Alinea Analytics puts about 40 million of the copies on PS5 and 13 million on Xbox Series X|S. That would place it above Cyberpunk 2077 and The Sims on the all-time list. Rockstar's own figure before launch was 32.5 million.
stories.next: Watch for official sales figures from Take-Two at its next earnings report.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: The estimate is 53 million copies in a single week.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: First-week revenue is estimated at $4.7 billion.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Grand Theft Auto is one of the best-selling series in gaming.

stories.background: GTA VI is Rockstar Games' latest Grand Theft Auto, released for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S in November 2026.

meme.top: GTA VI sold 53 million copies in a week
meme.bottom: Other top sellers took years
meme.take: GTA VI joined the all-time top 13 in a week. Most players are still in the tutorial.

stories.title: OpenAI fixes a GPT-6.2 billing error, so users hit limits up to 40% faster
stories.summary: OpenAI says a launch-period error over-discounted GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol usage, so after the fix usage limits arrive sooner.
stories.why: Paying subscribers effectively get less usage than they had last week, with no change in price.
stories.happened: The Decoder reports users now hit limits 40% faster on Astra and 25% faster on Sol than last week. OpenAI says there are no retroactive charges, eligible subscribers get one extra usage reset, and Business users get free Fast Mode through 2026.
stories.next: Watch for whether OpenAI adjusts plan limits or pricing after user complaints.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Subscribers pay the same price for noticeably less usage.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: The change affects most users of the two GPT-6.2 models, reports say.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: AI companies keep adjusting usage caps as demand for computing grows.

stories.background: OpenAI is the company behind ChatGPT and the GPT family of AI models.

meme.top: OpenAI found a billing mistake
meme.bottom: in your favour, and fixed it
meme.take: OpenAI corrected an error that was costing it money. Users were less moved by the integrity.

stories.title: Nvidia reportedly pauses AI server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries
stories.summary: Nvidia has reportedly told partners including Dell and Super Micro to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia.
stories.why: Southeast Asia is a fast-growing data centre hub, and billions in projects depend on these chips.
stories.happened: TechCrunch, citing the Wall Street Journal, says Nvidia is checking regional partners' compliance with US export rules. A Commerce Department rule gives regional cloud providers 90 days to get export licences. The Justice Department is reportedly probing suspected chip smuggling.
stories.next: Watch for how long the pause lasts and whether Nvidia confirms it.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Four countries and many data centre projects are affected, reports say.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Projects and their financing could stall without chips.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It follows tighter US export rules for the region.

stories.background: Nvidia is the leading maker of the chips used to train and run AI models.

meme.top: Nvidia sells the chips everyone wants
meme.bottom: Now it is checking who wants them
meme.take: Nvidia paused shipments to four countries to check the paperwork. The paperwork is winning.

stats.label: for cloud firms to get licences

stories.title: Macy's 100th Thanksgiving parade runs today after its first-ever weather delay
stories.summary: The 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade moved to Saturday, November 28, after a nor'easter brought gusts above the balloon safety limit.
stories.why: It is a national TV tradition, and weather has never pushed it off Thanksgiving before.
stories.happened: CBS New York says gusts over 40 mph were forecast for Thursday, above the 34 mph limit for large balloons. Saturday's parade runs 8:30am to noon ET on NBC and Peacock. NBC aired a replay of the 2025 parade on Thursday.
stories.next: Watch for Saturday's viewing figures compared with last year's 34.3 million.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: This is the parade's 100th edition.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: It is the first weather postponement in the parade's history.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Moving off Thanksgiving tests whether viewers still tune in.

stories.background: The Macy's parade has run in New York since 1924 and is known for its giant character balloons.

meme.top: A century of giant balloons
meme.bottom: and the wind finally got a vote
meme.take: The Macy's parade survived a hundred years and then lost one argument with a nor'easter.

stories.title: PS5 stock stays extremely limited in the US through Black Friday
stories.summary: TechRadar says US PS5 stock is extremely limited, blaming global memory shortages and GTA VI, while UK retailers restock some bundles.
stories.why: Black Friday is the biggest console sales week, and many shoppers still cannot find one.
stories.happened: TechRadar found only pricey Best Buy listings and a refurbished PS5 Slim on PlayStation Direct in the US. In the UK, EE restocked PS5 Slim bundles from £644.98. PS5 Pro stock remains scarce, with no Pro deals.
stories.next: Watch for restocks from Sony and major retailers before Christmas.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: GTA VI is driving people to buy consoles.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Global memory and component shortages are limiting supply, TechRadar says.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The shortage lands on the biggest shopping week of the year.

stories.background: The PS5 is Sony's current console, launched in 2020. The PS5 Pro followed in 2024.

meme.top: Black Friday is all about PS5 deals
meme.bottom: Step one: find a PS5
meme.take: This Black Friday's best PS5 deal is the refurbished one you can actually buy.

stories.title: Silksong's free Sea of Sorrow expansion arrives on December 11
stories.summary: Team Cherry confirmed the date in its Cherry Time! showcase and also launched a publishing label, Team Cherry Presents.
stories.why: Silksong was one of the most awaited indie games ever, and this is its first big expansion.
stories.happened: GamesRadar+ says Team Cherry calls Sea of Sorrow an expansion unlike any it has made, with pirate bugs, cannons and giant pirate bosses. The label's first games include The Botanist and the Translator, made by Hornet's voice actor Makoto Koji.
stories.next: Watch for release dates for the three Team Cherry Presents games.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Silksong fans waited years for the game and follow every update.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Silksong's success is paying for Team Cherry's new publishing label, reports say.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The expansion lands just two weeks after the showcase.

stories.background: Team Cherry is the small Australian studio behind Hollow Knight. Silksong, its sequel, launched in September 2025.

meme.top: Silksong fans are used to waiting
meme.bottom: Two weeks feels like a typo
meme.take: Team Cherry gave a release date two weeks away, which by its standards is a surprise drop.

stories.title: Anthropic reportedly buys Stainless, the SDK maker used by OpenAI and Google
stories.summary: Anthropic has reportedly acquired Stainless for over $300 million, and Stainless's hosted services for other clients are set to end.
stories.why: Rival AI labs relied on the same small startup to give developers their software kits.
stories.happened: The Economic Times reports the deal was worth more than $300 million. Stainless built developer SDKs that OpenAI and Google offered, and reports say those hosted services will be shut down after the purchase.
stories.next: Watch for how OpenAI and Google replace the tools and whether Anthropic confirms the terms.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: The deal takes a shared supplier away from two of Anthropic's biggest competitors.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: The reported price is above $300 million.

stories.background: Anthropic is the AI company that makes the Claude models. SDKs are code libraries developers use to connect apps to a service.

meme.top: OpenAI and Google used the same startup
meme.bottom: Anthropic used its credit card
meme.take: Anthropic found an efficient way to annoy two rivals at once: buy their plumbing.

stories.title: Ransomware gang's November 28 leak deadline for Nvidia arrives
stories.summary: The Gentlemen ransomware group claims to have Nvidia data and set today as its leak deadline. Nvidia says it sees no sign its systems were hit.
stories.why: A leak tied to the leading AI chipmaker could expose sensitive partner or product data.
stories.happened: BleepingComputer reports the group listed Nvidia on its leak site on November 18 but has shown no evidence. Nvidia says it found no indication its systems or networks were affected and is investigating an incident at an unnamed external partner.
stories.next: Watch for whether the group publishes anything and what Nvidia's partner investigation finds.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Nvidia is at the centre of the AI chip boom.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The group's deadline falls today.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Partner breaches can expose data even when a company's own systems are safe.

stories.background: Ransomware gangs steal or lock data and threaten to publish it unless they are paid.

meme.top: The hackers set a deadline
meme.bottom: but skipped the evidence
meme.take: A ransomware gang claims to have Nvidia data but has shown none, a bold approach to threats.

stats.label: leak deadline set by the group

stories.title: FCC approves SpaceX plan for up to one million AI data centre satellites
stories.summary: The FCC has given SpaceX conditional approval for Starmind, a planned network of up to one million computing satellites in orbit.
stories.why: It is the largest bet yet that AI data centres could move off the ground and into space.
stories.happened: The Neuron calls the approval conditional, and FCC Chair Brendan Carr said it serves the public interest. SpaceX must deploy at least one authorised station by 2033. Critics question heat dissipation and warn about space debris.
stories.next: Watch for SpaceX's first Starmind launch plans and any challenges from astronomers.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Up to one million satellites is far more than any network in orbit today.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Elon Musk's SpaceX already runs the Starlink satellite network.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Scientists warn about debris and question whether cooling in space can work.

stories.background: SpaceX is Elon Musk's rocket company and runs the Starlink satellite internet network.

meme.top: One million satellites approved
meme.bottom: The night sky has a landlord now
meme.take: Space was the last place without a data centre. The FCC has fixed that.

stories.title: Focker-In-Law takes No. 2 on Thanksgiving Day with $7.7 million
stories.summary: The fourth Meet the Parents film made $7.7 million on Thanksgiving Day and is projected to take about $40 million over five days.
stories.why: It tests whether a comedy sequel 16 years after the last one can still draw a holiday crowd.
stories.happened: TheWrap reports $13 million so far and a five-day projection near $40 million, plus about $30 million expected overseas this weekend. The film cost $90 million, co-financed by Universal and Paramount, and earned a B+ CinemaScore.
stories.next: Watch for whether word of mouth lifts it this weekend.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Meet the Parents was a hit comedy series in the 2000s.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Its $90 million budget is high for a comedy.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It is fighting Disney's Hexed for second place.

stories.background: Meet the Parents is a comedy series about a nurse and his fearsome ex-CIA father-in-law.

meme.top: The Fockers are back for a fourth time
meme.bottom: Thanksgiving with in-laws, but optional
meme.take: Focker-In-Law sold Thanksgiving with the in-laws to people who were already having it.

stories.title: Disney's Hexed lands third on Thanksgiving Day, below its early tracking
stories.summary: Disney's animated Hexed made about $4.5 million on Thanksgiving Day and is projected near $34 million over five days.
stories.why: A soft start for a costly original film raises questions about Disney Animation's non-sequel bets.
stories.happened: TheWrap reports $12 million so far, a five-day projection of about $34 million, an A- CinemaScore and a budget of about $200 million. Pirates & Princesses says the five-day forecast was $40 to $45 million before release.
stories.next: Watch for how well it holds in December as families catch up with it.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Its budget is about $200 million before marketing.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Thanksgiving is a traditional release slot for Disney animation.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It is up against a Hunger Games film and a comedy sequel.

stories.background: Disney animation has often released films over Thanksgiving, including Frozen in 2013.

meme.top: Disney cast a $200 million spell
meme.bottom: The box office asked for a receipt
meme.take: Audiences gave Hexed an A-. Its $200 million budget is still waiting for its grade.

stories.title: Ubisoft says generative AI is not required after a report on pitch rules
stories.summary: Ubisoft says its projects are not required to use generative AI, after Vertical Slice reported teams must justify not using it.
stories.why: Developers worry AI mandates will change how games are made and who keeps their jobs.
stories.happened: Vertical Slice, citing anonymous staff, says pitches must explain how generative AI could speed up production. Ubisoft says it encourages teams to explore AI but does not require it. Epic CEO Tim Sweeney posted that the productivity gains are enormous.
stories.next: Watch for any formal Ubisoft policy on AI in game development.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Staff describe pressure to use AI, which Ubisoft disputes.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Epic's Tim Sweeney weighed in publicly.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Big publishers are pushing generative AI into production.

stories.background: Ubisoft is the French publisher behind Assassin's Creed and Far Cry.

meme.top: Ubisoft says AI is not mandatory
meme.bottom: Just explain why you said no
meme.take: Ubisoft says AI is optional, the way a pop quiz is optional if you enjoy explaining yourself.

stories.title: S&P puts Nvidia on watch for a possible credit downgrade
stories.summary: S&P Global placed Nvidia's AA ratings on negative CreditWatch, citing governance concerns after Jensen Huang's exit and return as CEO.
stories.why: A credit warning over governance is unusual for a company of Nvidia's size and profits.
stories.happened: Tom's Hardware reports S&P cut its management and governance assessment from positive to neutral and plans to meet Nvidia's board. Huang resigned and was reinstated 11 days later. Semafor says Moody's moved its outlook from positive to stable.
stories.next: Watch for S&P's decision after its meeting with Nvidia's board.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: A downgrade could raise Nvidia's borrowing costs.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: The concern is about board independence, not sales.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Jensen Huang's exit and return has dominated tech news.

stories.background: Jensen Huang co-founded Nvidia in 1993 and has led it as chief executive since then.

meme.top: Nvidia's CEO left and came back
meme.bottom: The credit agency would like a word
meme.take: Nvidia's CEO took an 11-day break, and S&P would now like to check the board's homework.

stories.title: Netflix's The Trials of Karen Read tops US streaming charts
stories.summary: The three-part docuseries about the Karen Read case was Netflix's No. 1 US show on November 24 and 25, according to FlixPatrol.
stories.why: True crime is one of streaming's biggest draws, and this case was followed closely for years.
stories.happened: Men's Journal reports the series, released on November 23 and directed by Danielle Johnson Cutts, also ranked first in the UK, Canada, Australia and Ireland on November 24. It includes interviews with John O'Keefe's family and jurors.
stories.next: Watch for Netflix's official weekly viewing figures.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: True crime documentaries regularly top streaming charts.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: The televised trials drew a large online following.

stories.background: Karen Read was tried in Massachusetts over the 2022 death of her boyfriend, Boston police officer John O'Keefe.

meme.top: A true crime series tops the charts
meme.bottom: in several countries at once
meme.take: A docuseries about the Karen Read case is now Netflix's most-watched US show.

stories.title: SAP is reportedly weighing at least 10,000 job cuts in an AI overhaul
stories.summary: Bloomberg reports SAP is considering cutting at least 10,000 jobs, about 9% of its staff, as it restructures around AI.
stories.why: It would be one of the largest AI-linked cuts at a major software company.
stories.happened: The report, relayed by IT Home, says product, engineering and sales are the main areas under review and the final number has not been decided. SAP had not confirmed the plan in the coverage seen.
stories.next: Watch for a statement from SAP and any formal restructuring announcement.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: At least 10,000 jobs are reportedly under consideration.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Companies increasingly cite AI when they restructure.

stories.background: SAP is a German company whose software runs finance, supply chains and HR for many large businesses.

meme.top: SAP is planning its AI future
meme.bottom: with about 9% fewer people in it
meme.take: SAP's AI overhaul may reportedly start with the oldest efficiency tool there is: fewer jobs.

stories.title: US chip curbs are reportedly slowing Chinese AI labs' next models
stories.summary: Reuters reports Z.AI is behind schedule on its next flagship model as US chip curbs and a distillation crackdown bite.
stories.why: Chinese labs are a major source of strong open-weight models, so delays matter well beyond China.
stories.happened: Reuters says Z.AI's next flagship is reportedly running late. Moonshot AI reportedly expects the gap between its major releases to grow from about six months to a year or more if it loses access to overseas computing.
stories.next: Watch for release dates from Z.AI and Moonshot AI and any new US export rules.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: The US and China are competing to lead in AI.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Losing overseas computing could double the time between big releases, reports say.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The report lands as Nvidia reportedly pauses server shipments to Southeast Asia.

stories.background: Z.AI and Moonshot AI are Chinese AI startups known for releasing open-weight models.

meme.top: Release cycles used to be six months
meme.bottom: Export controls offer a scenic route
meme.take: Moonshot AI may wait a year between models, which in AI counts as a sabbatical.

stories.title: Rockstar UK staff vote 75% against union recognition
stories.summary: Rockstar's UK employees voted 75% to 25% against recognising the IWGB union, on a turnout of just over 93%.
stories.why: It is one of the biggest union votes in games, at the studio behind the year's top release.
stories.happened: PC Gamer reports 1,544 employees voted. The IWGB says it will keep organising, while Rockstar's head of publishing Jennifer Kolbe said the result reflects support for direct relationships with the company.
stories.next: Watch for the IWGB's next steps at Rockstar's UK studios.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The vote follows GTA VI's record launch.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: More than 1,500 staff took part.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Union drives have spread across game studios in recent years.

stories.background: Rockstar Games has several UK studios, including Rockstar North in Edinburgh, which leads GTA development.

meme.top: Rockstar staff held a big vote
meme.bottom: 93% turned up, which beats meetings
meme.take: Rockstar's union vote drew 93% turnout, a figure most staff surveys only dream of.

stories.title: AI shopping agents' traffic to US retailers is estimated up 150-fold
stories.summary: Human Security estimates AI agent traffic to US retail sites has risen about 150-fold this holiday season.
stories.why: Black Friday is the first big test of AI agents shopping on people's behalf.
stories.happened: BigGo Finance, citing Human Security, says Meta's Muse agent accounts for nearly 70% of AI-driven retail traffic. Semafor separately reports retailers are leaning on AI shopping tools while recent cyberattacks expose gaps in cyber insurance.
stories.next: Watch for retailers' post-holiday figures on how many agent visits turned into sales.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The estimate lands in the biggest shopping week of the year.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Meta's Muse agent is said to drive most of the traffic.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Tech firms are pushing agents that browse and buy for users.

stories.background: Human Security is a company that tracks bots and other automated traffic on websites.

meme.top: The busiest Black Friday shoppers
meme.bottom: never needed a parking space
meme.take: AI agents are flooding US stores this season, and not one of them wants a gift receipt.

stats.label: Muse share of AI traffic, est.

stories.title: Mario Kart World's free update adds eight remixed tracks
stories.summary: Nintendo's version 1.9.0 update for the Switch 2 racer adds eight returning tracks, two Knockout Tour routes and automatic replay saving.
stories.why: Free new tracks keep Nintendo's biggest Switch 2 game busy through the holidays.
stories.happened: VGC reports the tracks include DK Pass 2, Koopa Troopa Beach 2, Shy Guy Bazaar 2 and Wario Stadium 2. The new 24-player Knockout Tour routes are Feather Rally and Lucky Cat Rally.
stories.next: Watch for Nintendo's plans for further Mario Kart World updates.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: The tracks revisit courses from older Mario Kart games.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Players have asked for more courses since launch.

stories.background: Mario Kart World launched alongside the Nintendo Switch 2 in June 2025.

meme.top: Nintendo added eight new tracks
meme.bottom: Every one of them is called 2
meme.take: Nintendo added eight tracks and numbered them all 2, saving everyone time on names.

stories.title: X launches parental controls for teen accounts
stories.summary: X now lets parents supervise accounts of users aged 13 to 17, which default to a protected mode, TechCrunch reports.
stories.why: Social networks face growing pressure from governments and parents to protect teens.
stories.happened: Parents can see weekly usage, set daily limits, filter words, approve followers and manage messages, but cannot read DMs. Both sides must agree to supervision, one parent can oversee up to five teens, and it ends at 18.
stories.next: Watch for how many families use it and how regulators respond.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Platforms are adding teen protections under regulatory pressure.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: TechCrunch notes it comes about 20 years after the service began.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: X is owned by Elon Musk.

stories.background: X is the social network formerly called Twitter, owned by Elon Musk.

meme.top: Twitter launched in 2006
meme.bottom: Parental controls arrived on schedule
meme.take: X added parental controls after two decades, roughly when its first users' kids became teens.

stories.title: Blade Runner 2099 arrives on Prime Video with Michelle Yeoh and Hunter Schafer
stories.summary: Amazon's eight-episode Blade Runner series premiered on November 25 and holds a 70% critics' score on Rotten Tomatoes.
stories.why: It is the first live-action Blade Runner series, extending a cult science-fiction franchise.
stories.happened: Rotten Tomatoes lists a 70% Tomatometer from 66 reviews and a 52% audience score. The series was created by Silka Luisa, with Ridley Scott as an executive producer. Critics praise its visuals and its two leads.
stories.next: Watch for audience numbers from Amazon and any news on a second season.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Blade Runner is one of the most influential science-fiction films.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Michelle Yeoh won the best actress Oscar in 2023.

drivers.label: Mixed reviews
drivers.text: Critics rate it well above audiences so far.

stories.background: Blade Runner is Ridley Scott's 1982 film about hunting artificial humans. A sequel, Blade Runner 2049, followed in 2017.

meme.top: Blade Runner asks what makes us human
meme.bottom: Audiences said about 52%
meme.take: Critics gave Blade Runner 2099 a 70%. Audiences are still running their empathy test.

stories.title: Switzerland says AI agents were used in five recent cyberattacks
stories.summary: Switzerland's federal cybersecurity office reports five recent attacks involving AI agents against businesses and infrastructure operators.
stories.why: It is an official count of attacks in which AI agents did part of the work.
stories.happened: Reuters reports the attacks targeted businesses and critical-infrastructure operators. The news comes the same week Microsoft described ARTEX, an AI framework state-backed hackers use to automate intrusions.
stories.next: Watch for details from Swiss authorities on how the attacks worked.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Agents can automate steps that once needed skilled human attackers.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Microsoft reported state hackers using AI tools in the same week.

stories.background: AI agents are AI systems that can carry out multi-step tasks, such as running software tools, with little human input.

meme.top: AI agents were promised office jobs
meme.bottom: Some went into breaking and entering
meme.take: AI agents were sold as tireless digital workers. A few have found work in burglary.

stories.title: Playground says Fable has more than 150,000 lines of dialogue
stories.summary: Fable's general manager Ralph Fulton says the game has more than 150,000 lines of dialogue and over 100 voice actors.
stories.why: It signals the size of Xbox's long-awaited reboot of a well-loved RPG series.
stories.happened: Fulton told GamesIndustry.biz voice recording took more than 1,000 hours this year across studios working in parallel. GamesRadar+ says that is more than Skyrim and Mass Effect 3 combined. Xbox puts the main story at 15 to 20 hours.
stories.next: Watch for a release date from Xbox.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Over 150,000 lines is a very large script for an RPG.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: The Fable series began in 2004 and has a loyal following.

stories.background: Fable is a fantasy RPG series that began in 2004. The new game is made by Playground Games, owned by Microsoft's Xbox.

meme.top: Fable has 150,000 lines of dialogue
meme.bottom: The main story takes 15 hours
meme.take: Fable has over 150,000 lines of dialogue, so every villager has thoughts on your haircut.

stories.title: Dutch consumer groups sue to halt Meta's AI glasses in the Netherlands
stories.summary: Consumentenbond and Offlimits filed a suit in Amsterdam claiming Meta's AI glasses allow covert filming that breaches EU privacy law.
stories.why: Camera glasses are a growing product category, and Europe's privacy rules could limit how they work.
stories.happened: IT Home, citing Reuters, says the groups want sales stopped and an end to recording bystanders and using footage for AI training. They propose penalties of €100,000 per defendant per day, capped at €100 million. There is no ruling yet.
stories.next: Watch for the Amsterdam court's first hearing and Meta's response.

drivers.label: Privacy
drivers.text: Bystanders may not know they are being filmed, the groups argue.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: The proposed penalties could reach €100 million.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Meta is the leading seller of camera smart glasses.

stories.background: Meta owns Facebook and Instagram and sells camera-equipped smart glasses made with Ray-Ban maker EssilorLuxottica.

meme.top: Meta's glasses can film everything
meme.bottom: Dutch lawyers have noticed
meme.take: Meta built glasses that see everything. Dutch consumer groups want them to see a courtroom.

stories.title: Google's Cogentic research agent posts six maths papers in a single day
stories.summary: A Google Research AI agent built with Gemini 4 produced six mathematics papers on November 25 and posted them publicly on GitHub.
stories.why: AI systems producing research at volume raises the question of how mathematicians check the results.
stories.happened: Dealroom reports the papers, generated with Gemini 4, deal with bounds on factoring and were posted to a public GitHub repository. Separately, computer scientist Scott Aaronson argued that AI systems producing proofs matters beyond academia.
stories.next: Watch for mathematicians' reviews of whether the six papers hold up.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Six papers in one day is far faster than human researchers work.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Google's Gemini 4 model powers the agent.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: AI labs are racing to show their models can do original maths.

stories.background: Google Research is Google's research division. Gemini is Google's family of AI models.

meme.top: Six maths papers in one day
meme.bottom: Checking them may take a bit longer
meme.take: Google's agent produced six maths papers in a day, roughly six more than this headline.

stories.title: Brad Pitt's Cliff Booth film makes about $910,000 on its IMAX opening day
stories.summary: Netflix's IMAX-only release of The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth is projected to make about $3.5 million over five days.
stories.why: It is Netflix's first IMAX release, a test of whether the streamer can sell cinema tickets.
stories.happened: JoBlo, citing Variety, reports $910,000 from 252 IMAX screens on opening day. Variety projects about $3.5 million over the five-day holiday. The David Fincher film reaches Netflix on December 23.
stories.next: Watch for whether Netflix extends the run or reports its grosses.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Brad Pitt stars and David Fincher directs.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: It is Netflix's first release in IMAX.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It opened against a busy Thanksgiving slate.

stories.background: Cliff Booth was Brad Pitt's stuntman character in the 2019 film Once Upon a Time in Hollywood.

meme.top: Netflix finally put a film in cinemas
meme.bottom: for two weeks, then back to the sofa
meme.take: Netflix discovered cinemas this week and is treating them like a short holiday rental.

stories.title: New Switch 2 hack lets jailbroken consoles run dumped games
stories.summary: An open-source tool called nx2-relink turns Switch 2 game dumps into homebrew programs that run natively, tbreak reports.
stories.why: It is a step toward wider Switch 2 piracy, which Nintendo fights hard.
stories.happened: tbreak says the tool, by Olmectron, is a fork of nx-relink first reported by GBAtemp. It runs games without emulation and only works on consoles running firmware older than 23.5.0.
stories.next: Watch for Nintendo's response, such as firmware updates or legal action.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Running dumped games opens the door to piracy.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Nintendo and console hackers have long played cat and mouse.

stories.background: The Switch 2 is Nintendo's current console, released in June 2025.

meme.top: Nintendo built a new console
meme.bottom: Hackers built a new hobby
meme.take: Switch 2 hackers can now run dumped games, provided they never, ever update.

stories.title: Microsoft says state hackers have adopted the ARTEX AI hacking tool
stories.summary: Microsoft says state-backed groups from China and North Korea, including Salt Typhoon, now use the AI penetration-testing tool ARTEX.
stories.why: AI tools that automate attacks could make skilled hacking faster and cheaper.
stories.happened: The Record reports ARTEX automates stages of an intrusion using existing penetration-testing tools, and Microsoft says criminal groups use it too. The Decoder says Microsoft recommends defensive deception to slow such attacks.
stories.next: Watch for security vendors' guidance on detecting ARTEX-driven attacks.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Automated attacks can hit more targets with fewer people.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Microsoft's threat intelligence team made the findings.

stories.background: Salt Typhoon is a China-linked hacking group known for breaching telecom networks.

meme.top: Hackers adopted an AI assistant
meme.bottom: Productivity is up across the board
meme.take: State hackers are automating attacks with AI. Someone finally got the efficiency gains.

stories.title: Capcom will shut down Exoprimal's servers in September 2027
stories.summary: Capcom will delist its dinosaur hero shooter and its DLC on March 30, 2027, and close the servers on September 29, 2027.
stories.why: Another live-service shutdown adds to players' worries about online-only games disappearing.
stories.happened: PC Gamer reports the game launched in 2023 and stopped getting new updates in 2024. SteamDB showed a 24-hour peak of 23 concurrent players on Steam.
stories.next: Watch for whether Capcom adds any offline mode before the shutdown.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Online-only games keep shutting down within a few years of launch.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Capcom is one of Japan's biggest game publishers.

stories.background: Capcom is the Japanese publisher behind Resident Evil and Monster Hunter.

meme.top: A dinosaur game is going extinct
meme.bottom: with plenty of notice this time
meme.take: Exoprimal's dinosaurs will go extinct in 2027, a meteor scheduled well in advance.

stories.title: Huawei teases its next AI memory chip to rival Samsung and SK Hynix
stories.summary: Huawei has teased a next-generation high-bandwidth memory chip for AI, Bloomberg reports, aiming at Samsung and SK Hynix.
stories.why: Memory is a choke point for AI hardware, and US curbs limit China's access to it.
stories.happened: Bloomberg says the chip has been teased but not launched. Separately, Huawei said at a HarmonyOS event this week that devices running its own operating system have passed 100 million.
stories.next: Watch for launch details and specifications.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Huawei is taking on the South Korean leaders in AI memory.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: US curbs limit China's access to foreign memory chips.

stories.background: High-bandwidth memory (HBM) is stacked memory that feeds data to AI chips. Samsung and SK Hynix are leading makers.

meme.top: Huawei teased a new memory chip
meme.bottom: Samsung will remember this
meme.take: Huawei says its next AI memory chip is coming. The specs, like the chip, are still a teaser.

stories.title: Denny's restores Jensen Huang's plaque after his return to Nvidia
stories.summary: Denny's posted on X that it had restored a commemorative plaque to Nvidia's CEO and invited him back to his booth.
stories.why: The diner chain linked to Nvidia's founding turned a boardroom saga into a brand moment.
stories.happened: Tom's Hardware reports Denny's posted a roughly 200-word statement after Huang was reinstated. It says management put his plaque back after it had been removed and invited him to return to his booth.
stories.next: Watch for whether Huang takes up the invitation.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Nvidia's founders famously planned the company at a Denny's.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Huang's return as CEO has been one of the week's biggest tech stories.

stories.background: Nvidia's founders planned the company at a Denny's restaurant in San Jose in 1993.

meme.top: Nvidia's CEO is back at work
meme.bottom: So is his booth at Denny's
meme.take: Wall Street debated Nvidia's governance. Denny's settled it with a plaque and a booth.

stories.title: Canada adds C$700 million to its AI compute fund and will cover up to 80%
stories.summary: Canada expanded its AI Compute Access Fund to C$1 billion and will cover up to 80% of eligible costs bought from sovereign providers.
stories.why: Governments are paying to keep AI computing, and the firms that run it, inside their own borders.
stories.happened: BetaKit reports the extra C$700 million brings the fund to C$1 billion. Ottawa will now pay up to 80% of eligible computing costs when companies buy from qualifying sovereign providers.
stories.next: Watch for which providers qualify and how quickly companies apply.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: The fund grows to C$1 billion.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Countries are funding sovereign AI computing at home.

stories.background: Sovereign compute means AI computing infrastructure that is owned and run within a country.

meme.top: Canada will pay 80% of your AI bill
meme.bottom: if the computer stays in the country
meme.take: Canada's new AI deal: the government pays 80%, you pay 20% and the servers stay home.

stories.title: Lords of the Fallen II slips again, now to April 2027
stories.summary: CI Games' CEO says the soulslike sequel will launch in April 2027, with the exact date to be announced in December.
stories.why: It is the second delay for one of next year's bigger action games.
stories.happened: CEO Marek Tyminski posted the new window, AllKeyShop reports. The game had already moved from 2026 to early 2027 in June. No reason was given. It is coming to PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Switch 2 and PC.
stories.next: Watch for the exact release date in December.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Publishers have been moving games away from GTA VI's launch period.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Soulslike action games have a large, dedicated audience.

stories.background: Lords of the Fallen is a dark fantasy action series from Polish publisher CI Games. The 2023 game was a reboot.

meme.top: Lords of the Fallen II has a new date
meme.bottom: The date has a date in December
meme.take: Lords of the Fallen II moved to April, then promised to say which day in April. Progress.

stories.title: CBS says Nvidia sold top chips to two Chinese-owned California firms
stories.summary: A CBS News investigation says Nvidia sold some of its most advanced chips to two Chinese-owned California companies.
stories.why: It suggests US export curbs on top AI chips can be sidestepped through domestic buyers.
stories.happened: CBS reports the two firms leased or sold some of the chips to companies in Asia. The Next Web separately reports chip sellers warned specialised cloud firms they could lose GPU access if they rent computing to Chinese companies.
stories.next: Watch for any response from the Commerce Department or new rules on domestic buyers.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: The findings raise questions about how well export rules work.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: The US is trying to limit China's access to top AI chips.

stories.background: US rules restrict sales of the most powerful AI chips to China over national security concerns.

meme.top: Two California firms got Nvidia chips
meme.bottom: The owners lived a bit further away
meme.take: The chips stayed in California. The ownership took a longer flight.

stories.title: Anthropic says Claude agents moved its API from Python to Rust
stories.summary: Anthropic reports that Claude agents migrated its Messages API to Rust, cutting processor use per request by about 70%.
stories.why: It is a large real-world test of AI agents doing major engineering work on production systems.
stories.happened: Agents compared the old and new versions against live requests, and engineers reviewed the fixes. Anthropic reports about 70% less processor use per request and a 20% shorter median time to first token.
stories.next: Watch for other companies reporting similar agent-led code migrations.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: An AI company had its own model rebuild a core product.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Lower processor use per request cuts serving costs.

stories.background: Anthropic is the AI company that makes the Claude models.

meme.top: Claude rewrote the code it runs on
meme.bottom: A rare tenant who renovates
meme.take: Anthropic's agents rewrote its API in Rust, a language engineers usually only threaten to use.

stories.title: Jennifer Lopez's Las Vegas residency film airs on CBS and Paramount+
stories.summary: The JLo Show: Live in Las Vegas aired on CBS on Thanksgiving night, with an extended version streaming on Paramount+.
stories.why: Holiday TV specials draw big family audiences, and Lopez is one of pop's best-known names.
stories.happened: Music Times reports the special films the final show of her residency at Caesars Palace's Colosseum, which ran 12 sold-out shows and ended on March 28. It aired from 8 to 10pm on November 26.
stories.next: Watch for ratings from the Thanksgiving night broadcast.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Jennifer Lopez is a long-running pop and film star.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It aired on Thanksgiving night, when many families watch TV together.

stories.background: Jennifer Lopez is a singer and actor whose hits include Jenny From the Block.

meme.top: Jennifer Lopez played Vegas 12 times
meme.bottom: Now Vegas comes to your sofa
meme.take: Lopez's residency ended in March, so CBS served it up again with the Thanksgiving leftovers.

stories.title: Fans think EA's Iron Man game could appear at The Game Awards
stories.summary: A refreshed EA Motive website has fans speculating that its long-quiet Iron Man game will show up at The Game Awards on December 10.
stories.why: The game has been almost silent for years, and The Game Awards is where big reveals happen.
stories.happened: KitGuru reports a Reddit user spotted the overhaul of EA Motive's website. The Game Awards stream on Disney+ for the first time this year, and Disney has promised major announcements. Nothing about Iron Man is confirmed.
stories.next: Watch for official teasers from EA or Marvel before December 10.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Fans have waited years for news on the game.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Iron Man is one of Marvel's best-known heroes.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The Game Awards are less than two weeks away.

stories.background: EA Motive is the Montreal studio that made the Dead Space remake. Iron Man is Marvel's armoured superhero.

meme.top: Iron Man has been quiet for years
meme.bottom: A website update is now big news
meme.take: EA refreshed a website, and Iron Man fans began drafting their reaction videos.

stories.title: EU may vote on approving Tesla's assisted driving system on December 15
stories.summary: A draft European Commission agenda shows a possible vote on authorising Tesla's assisted driving system at a December 15 meeting, Reuters reports.
stories.why: Approval would open Europe to a driver-assistance feature Tesla already sells in the US.
stories.happened: Reuters says the item appears on a draft agenda for the meeting and no decision has been made. Draft agendas can still change before the meeting.
stories.next: Watch for the final agenda and the outcome of the December 15 meeting.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Tesla is Elon Musk's carmaker.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: A vote could come within weeks.

stories.background: Tesla is Elon Musk's electric car company. Its driver-assistance software requires a human to supervise.

meme.top: Tesla's car can almost drive itself
meme.bottom: EU paperwork, not yet
meme.take: Tesla's assisted driving is on Europe's agenda, where it moves at the speed of committees.

stories.title: Japanese residents push back against data centres built near homes
stories.summary: Reuters reports growing resistance from urban residents in Japan as data centres for AI computing move into neighbourhoods.
stories.why: The AI building boom is running into local opposition over where its huge facilities go.
stories.happened: Reuters says residents in Japanese cities are opposing data centres planned close to homes as the country expands computing for AI. SATS's CEO separately told Reuters that air cargo demand for AI data centre gear shows no sign of slowing.
stories.next: Watch for local rules in Japan on where data centres can be built.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: AI is driving a wave of data centre construction worldwide.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Residents object to large facilities next to housing.

stories.background: Data centres are buildings full of servers. AI needs many of them, along with large amounts of power and cooling.

meme.top: Japan's AI boom needed more room
meme.bottom: The neighbours have opinions
meme.take: Japan's data centres are moving in next door, and nobody brought a welcome gift.

stories.title: The Hunting Wives returns to Netflix with an eight-episode second season
stories.summary: Netflix released all eight episodes of The Hunting Wives' second season on November 26, with Malin Akerman and Brittany Snow back.
stories.why: The first season was a streaming hit, and a holiday-weekend release gives the new one plenty of viewers.
stories.happened: What's on Netflix lists new cast members including John Stamos, Angel Reese, Cam Gigandet and Dale Dickey. How-To Geek named it one of the holiday weekend's top new shows.
stories.next: Watch for whether it enters Netflix's weekly top 10.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It arrived on Thanksgiving, a big weekend for streaming.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: John Stamos and basketball star Angel Reese join the cast.

stories.background: The Hunting Wives is a drama series about a woman drawn into a circle of wealthy, secretive friends.

meme.top: Thanksgiving with complicated friends
meme.bottom: now in eight convenient episodes
meme.take: Netflix released a season about toxic friendships on the day families gather. Bold scheduling.

stories.title: Amy Poehler and Hugh Laurie's comedy Dig lands on Peacock
stories.summary: Peacock released all ten episodes of Dig, a comedy co-run by Mike Schur and J.J. Philbin, on November 23.
stories.why: Poehler and Schur worked together on Parks and Recreation, so fans watch their new projects closely.
stories.happened: TheWrap reports the series stars Amy Poehler and Hugh Laurie alongside Geraldine Viswanathan, Antonia Thomas and Fina Strazza. How-To Geek lists it among the holiday weekend's top new shows.
stories.next: Watch for early reviews and whether Peacock orders a second season.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Amy Poehler and Hugh Laurie lead the cast.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Parks and Recreation fans follow Schur and Poehler's work.

stories.background: Peacock is the streaming service of NBCUniversal, the owner of NBC.

meme.top: Ten episodes released at once
meme.bottom: Peacock trusts you with your weekend
meme.take: Peacock dropped a whole Amy Poehler season on the one weekend nobody has plans besides eating.
